text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Please, give it your all for the
fall
season!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Look! I made this golden banner to
complement
your shimmering splendor!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Thank you very much. I will do
my utmost
every day to meet your
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what graceful hand waving...
McQueen's
elegance knows no bounds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I've never had the opportunity to speak
with her
trainer. But I imagine he's
wonderful too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I've never had the opportunity to speak
with her
trainer. But I imagine she's
wonderful too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan E
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm certain her trainer has exquisite
manners!
Someone personally selected
by McQueen could
never say anything
uncouth!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A chill runs down my spine. I feel I could
shatter
their image of me at any given
moment. Or
worse...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer? Why are you speaking like
that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely inexcusable. I need to learn
the basics
of proper etiquette as soon as
possible!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Goodness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fans
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Do you have a moment, Trainer? I have
a
suggestion for you today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we go somewhere else to talk
first?
Here, there are far too many eyes
on us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I believe we've covered enough
distance to be
safe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So, to get into the crux of things...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Take this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sploosh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry, I've prepared a water
gun for
you too! Now, go ahead and
douse me as much as
you see fit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I mean what I said. Come on, your guard
is
completely lowered!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Take this, and this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to wait! Hehe... hurry up
now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen doesn't appear willing
to hear
me out. So I follow her
instructions...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fine by me. Come at me with your best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm utterly soaked...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. There's no need to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In fact, it's precisely because you
approach
everything with such intensity
that I'm able to be
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you are and always have been a

wonderful person. Forcing yourself to
change is a
wasted effort.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
After all, you are the trainer that I,
Mejiro
McQueen, have personally
chosen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Should I take a photo of your face right
now to
serve as a reminder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That settles things, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my goodness, you're soaked from
head to toe!
What is the cause for this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh! Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, is that so?! I wouldn't expect
anything less
from you two! What tactful
thinking!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Silly you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should have taken a photo of
your face
after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...You look so much more dignified now.

text_block_list.text:

complement
your shimmering splendor!

expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! McQueen's trainer behaves just
as elegantly as
her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying how tight their
bond is!
Absolutely splendid!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
See how wonderful of a person you are
when you
act as your usual self and
don't resort to
pretenses?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So, please, do not force yourself any
further.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that is good to hear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, seeing you act all
formal...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Made me feel like I had lost something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Deary me. Ryan, why are you impeding
our way forward?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... McQueen's looking in
top shape today,
so I got curious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm? She looks the same as always to
me. Why, she's
even together with her
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I agree with Ryan, something feels
different. Look
at her eagerly awaiting
her trainer's next instructions!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Settle down now, Palmer. Lean
any further and
you might grab their
attention.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why are you all here?!

text_block_list.name: The Mejiros
text_block_list.text:
Eeek!
Aaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen, noticing the other
Mejiros
camping by the rocks, charges
after them
red-faced.
